description: Displays international draughts positions and plays out endgames.

attributes.name: draggable-pieces
attributes.description: Enables human moves by dragging, clicking or keyboard.

attributes.name: draggablepieces
attributes.description: HTML-normalized alias of the JavaScript property draggablePieces.

attributes.name: fen
attributes.description: Alias of position, synchronized after moves. Takes precedence on initial connection.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Side displayed at the bottom of the 10 by 10 board.

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Draughts FEN: side to move and numbered white/black piece lists. Prefix kings with K; ranges are accepted.

methods.name: clear(): void
methods.description: Removes all pieces and stops automatic play; the empty board cannot play moves.

methods.name: flip(): void
methods.description: Reverses the viewing orientation without changing the position or human side.

methods.name: highlightLegalMove(square?: string | number): Square[]
methods.description: Highlights and returns legal destination squares. Omit the square to clear highlights.

methods.name: legalMove(begin: string | number, end: string | number, path?: readonly (string | number)[]): boolean
methods.description: Tests a complete legal move. Supply a full path including origin if several capture routes share the same endpoint.

methods.name: legalMoves(square?: string | number): Move[]
methods.description: Returns independent descriptions of all complete legal moves, optionally restricted to one origin. Paths include the origin and every landing square.

methods.name: move(begin: string | number, end: string | number, path?: readonly (string | number)[]): boolean
methods.description: Plays one complete legal turn, including a whole capture sequence. Ambiguous endpoints require the full path; promotion is automatic.

methods.name: nextMove(): boolean
methods.description: Replays the next recorded half-move, or plays one random legal move at the end of the recording. Pauses automatic play.

methods.name: pause(): void
methods.description: Pauses playback without losing the current position or recorded moves.

methods.name: play(mode: CheckersPlayMode = "user/random", userSide: CheckersSide = "white", delay = 2000): boolean
methods.description: Starts user/random or random/random play from the current position. The human is White by default, independently of orientation. Default delay is 2000 ms; accepts 100–60000 ms.

methods.name: playToEnd(): boolean
methods.description: Replays recorded moves and then continues with random legal moves until the game ends or is paused.

methods.name: previousMove(): boolean
methods.description: Undoes one half-move and keeps it available for replay. Returns false at the beginning.

methods.name: reset(): void
methods.description: Restores the most recently loaded position, preserving its side to move. Stops automatic play.

methods.name: rewind(): void
methods.description: Returns to the loaded starting position while retaining played moves for replay. Pauses automatic play.

methods.name: setPosition(value: string | CheckersPosition): boolean
methods.description: Loads draughts FEN or a numbered piece map atomically. Returns false and emits an error if invalid; an empty map clears the board.

methods.name: start(): void
methods.description: Loads the international starting position with twenty men per side. Stops automatic play.

methods.name: stop(): void
methods.description: Stops the random opponent or autoplay. The current position remains on the board.

events.name: tp-checkers-change
events.description: Emitted after loading, playing or navigating a position.

events.name: tp-checkers-end
events.description: Emitted when a played move ends the game by a win or draw.

events.name: tp-checkers-error
events.description: Emitted for invalid positions or play parameters; the previous game remains unchanged.

events.name: tp-checkers-move
events.description: Emitted after a complete legal turn, including all captures and any promotion.
events.detail: { from: string; to: string; path: string[]; captures: { square: string; color: string; type: string }[]; promotion: boolean; fen: string }

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-checkers>` element displays international draughts positions and plays out endgames.
userHelp.interactions:
The header shows the game icon and name on the left. Rounded controls appear on the right, in this order: Reset, Undo, Redo, Help, chronometer, Color, Theme and Fullscreen. Additional game commands remain below the header.

#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| :tp-icon:{name="refresh"} Reset | Restores the loaded position or puzzle and resets the timer. |
| :tp-icon:{name="undo"} Undo | Takes back the last move. |
| :tp-icon:{name="redo"} Redo | Replays the next undone move. Disabled when there is no recorded continuation. |
| :tp-icon:{name="help"} Help | Opens the dropdown of assistance actions specific to this game. |
| Help → Highlight all legal destinations | Marks the final landing squares of complete legal capture sequences or moves. |
| Help → Play one random legal move | Pauses and replays the next recorded turn, or chooses a random legal turn at the end of history. |
| Help → Rules of the game | Opens a drawer with the rules of this game. |
| Chronometer | Displays elapsed play time; starts with play and pauses on completion. Reset clears it. |
| :tp-icon:{name="palette-swatch"} Color | Changes the brand color of this game only. |
| :tp-icon:{name="sun"} :tp-icon:{name="moon"} Theme | Changes the light, dark or automatic theme of this game only. |
| :tp-icon:{name="fullscreen"} :tp-icon:{name="fullscreen-exit"} Fullscreen | Enters or leaves fullscreen for this game. |
| Click a movable piece, then a marked square | Plays that legal move for the active side when human moves are enabled. If a capture ends on its origin, selecting that square plays the sequence; otherwise click the selected piece again to cancel. |
| Drag a movable piece | Moves it to a legal destination with mouse, pen or touch. An illegal drop leaves the position unchanged. |
| Choose capture path | Selects the full sequence when several legal capture routes share a destination. |
| :tp-icon:{name="chevron-left-first"} Back to beginning | Pauses and returns to the loaded starting position while keeping recorded moves for replay. |
| :tp-icon:{name="previous"} Previous move | Pauses and takes back one move, restoring every captured piece. |
| :tp-icon:{name="next"} Play one move | Pauses and replays the next recorded move, or chooses one random legal move if no recorded move remains. |
| :tp-icon:{name="play"} Play to end | Replays recorded moves and continues with random legal moves every two seconds until the game ends or Pause is pressed. |
| :tp-icon:{name="pause"} Pause | Pauses automatic play without discarding recorded moves. |
| Start | Loads the classical starting position with twenty men per side. |
| Flip | Displays the other side at the bottom without changing the turn. |
| Play vs random | Plays the side currently at the bottom against random legal replies. Enables human moves. |
| Random vs random | Automatically plays random legal moves for both sides. |
| Stop | Stops automatic play and preserves the current board. |
| Clear | Removes all pieces and stops automatic play. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Moves between the toolbar, board and available capture-path choices. |
| Arrow keys | Moves focus to the next playable square in the displayed direction, without wrapping across board edges. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Selects a piece or plays to the focused legal square when human moves are enabled; activates a focused toolbar or capture-path button. |
| <kbd>Escape</kbd> | Cancels a selection, drag or pending capture-path choice without playing a move. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Opens User help for the component under the pointer, falling back to focus. <kbd>Shift</kbd> may be needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Opens contextual component documentation. |
